title: eragrostis beninensis
intro: Eragrostis beninensis, commonly known as Benin grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional African medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Eragrostis beninensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and the management of fever and other infections. The bioactive constituents of Eragrostis beninensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
